Cookies.

The current public storefront does not intentionally set advertising, analytics, personalization, or marketing cookies.

Current public site

The public experience does not currently include a cookie preference manager because no optional tracking technologies have been enabled. Hosting infrastructure may use necessary technical mechanisms to deliver and protect the service.

Development and staging

Restricted non-production environments use Google and Firebase for sign-in and session storage to remember an authorized email address during the browser session. Those environments are for internal review and are not the public storefront.

External services

Social platforms and the restricted Stripe test-checkout experience may use their own cookies after a visitor follows a link or enters those services. Their notices and controls apply there.

Future state

If measurement, email, personalization, advertising, or public commerce tools are added, this page and any legally required consent controls will be updated before those tools are enabled.

Browser controls

Visitors can review or delete stored site data through their browser settings. At present, there is no optional Low Value Content cookie preference to manage on the public site.
